key_highlights: ASX limps to a modest weekly gain amid global tech leadership turmoil and AI capex re-evaluation.
Consumer discretionary faces severe headwinds highlighted by David Jones halving store footprint and restructuring.
Housing market stress accelerates with steepening price drops in Brisbane and Perth impacting mortgage books.
Australian dollar depreciation intensifies import cost pressures while global oil weakness offers disinflationary relief.

sectors.trend: Exploration momentum in gold and critical minerals offsets broader bulk commodity demand uncertainties.
sectors.implications: Junior explorers see capital inflows, while major miners balance FX benefits against softening export margins.

sectors.trend: Accelerating property valuation declines and regulatory enforcement elevate credit risk and compliance costs.
sectors.implications: Major banks face residential loan-to-value compression alongside heightened regulatory scrutiny.

sectors.trend: Structural retail distress deepens as legacy department stores downsize and luxury spend shifts to secondary channels.
sectors.implications: Discretionary earnings face severe downgrades; retail landlords face elevated vacancy and re-leasing risks.

sectors.trend: Resilient global thermal coal demand contrasts with falling crude oil benchmarks and domestic gas policy debates.
sectors.implications: Coal pure-plays capture firm cash generation, whereas upstream oil and LNG producers face revenue headwinds.

sectors.trend: Global governance turmoil and mounting skepticism over multi-trillion-dollar AI returns trigger valuation re-ratings.
sectors.implications: Heightened volatility and multiple compression across ASX-listed technology and cloud providers.

sectors.trend: Residential price corrections and retail footprint contractions threaten asset valuations.
sectors.implications: Retail REIT distributions face pressure from anchor tenant closures, while residential development margins contract.

key_themes: RBA terminal cash rate plateau amid cooling labour indicators and household debt strain.
AUD/USD depreciation exacerbating imported inflation while selectively boosting unhedged exporters.
Retail restructuring accelerating CBD and regional shopping center consolidation.
Tech valuation reset following mega-cap executive disruption and AI infrastructure scrutiny.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight lenders with elevated high-LVR mortgage exposures; prioritize banks with robust tier-1 capital buffers.
Hedge import-exposed operations and favor USD-denominated commodity earners over domestic retailers.
Reduce exposure to discretionary retail REITs; reallocate toward non-discretionary convenience and logistics assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Tech De-rating and AI Contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Trim high-multiple growth equities and rotate into defensive, high-dividend paying ASX constituents.
Focus fixed-income allocations on Commonwealth government bonds over lower-rated state semi-government debt.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Cash-Generative Bulk Energy and Gold Producers
opportunities.rationale: Sustained coal demand and gold exploration tailwinds amplified by local-currency margin expansion via AUD weakness.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Exposure to Fuel Cost Beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: Falling global oil prices reduce major cost lines for transport and aviation operators.
Strong performance in idiosyncratic micro-cap and healthcare turnarounds demonstrating market resilience.

defensive_moves.rationale: Mass store closures and retail footprint contractions threaten occupancy rates and rental income.
Global AI capex skepticism and semiconductor management shakeups drive valuation multiple compression.
Insulate portfolios against domestic property softening and broader economic deceleration.

market_outlook.short_term: Rangebound trading for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) between 8,100 and 8,350 as energy input relief offsets retail and tech headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Defensive posture over 6–12 months as the RBA holds rates steady amid softening employment data and housing market deleveraging.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statements and official cash rate deliberations.
Australian quarterly CPI inflation prints and monthly employment data.
Global semiconductor leadership appointments and tech capex guidance updates.
State mid-year budget reviews and rating agency credit assessments.
watch_list: CoreLogic residential home value index trends across Brisbane and Perth.
Thermal coal and global crude oil benchmark pricing.
ASX commercial retail REIT leasing spreads and vacancy rates.
